easy.title: Use {{tool}}
easy.description: After you connect a relay, Switch writes the local configs so both CLI and App clients can use it.
easy.toolsError: Could not read the tools. Please retry.
easy.servicesError: Could not read saved services. Please retry.
easy.keyPlaceholder: Paste the API Key from your provider
easy.keepKey: Leave empty to keep the saved Key
easy.modelDefault: Choose a model after entering the API URL
easy.modelsError: Could not read the model list. You can continue with the prefilled or default model, or check the provider site.
easy.needUrl: Enter the complete API base URL supplied by the provider.
easy.needKey: Paste the Key for this service.
easy.needModel: Choose a model from the list, or leave the provider default.
easy.prepareError: Setup did not finish. Saved information is retained; you can retry.
easy.driftError: Another program changed the tool configuration. Review it in Pro mode before connecting.
easy.manualInstall: Install this tool's CLI first. Switch to Pro mode in Settings for installation options.
easy.installError: CLI installation failed. Check your network and Node.js / npm（或本机已支持的安装方式） setup, then retry.
easy.installDescription: Using your existing npm (or the install method for your OS), Switch will install this tool's CLI (command line), then apply your service settings. It will not install the ChatGPT or Claude desktop apps. Node.js/npm (or the install method for your OS) is required; confirm any operating-system prompts yourself.
easy.preparingHint: This prepares the CLI (command line), not a desktop app.
easy.cancelled: Remaining steps cancelled. Installation or saving already in progress may finish, but the CLI terminal will not be opened.
easy.editDescription: Use the corresponding Key when changing the URL or service.
easy.ready: {{tool}} config is ready. Optional: open the CLI terminal.
easy.noKeyTitle: Where do I find the Key?
easy.noKeyDescription: Sign into your provider and open its API Key or Tokens page. Copy a Key and paste it here. It is not your account password.
easy.discover: Register and create a Key on a station

guide.title: Which tool do you want to use?
guide.description: Pick a tool and paste your service Key. Switch writes local configs for CLI and App clients. It does not install desktop apps for you.

folder.launchError: Could not open the CLI terminal. Check that the CLI is installed and its service configuration has not been changed elsewhere.

usage.title: Local usage
usage.empty: No local usage in the last 7 days yet.
usage.inspect: Select a date to inspect tokens
usage.referenceHint: Local records for this tool across all services. Cost uses public model prices; usage without matching prices is excluded. This is not the provider's actual charge.

easy.noKeyEmpty: No station list is available right now. Copy a Key from the provider site you purchased.
easy.pickService: Don't have a service? Browse services.
easy.notePlaceholder: Required, e.g. work Claude or personal line
easy.noteHint: Shown as the name in your service list.
easy.boundary: Switch does not install the ChatGPT / Claude desktop apps; your existing CLI or App uses the configs it writes.
easy.modelInfo: The model list is fetched live from the selected relay using the API base URL and Key you entered. The fetch fails if either is wrong or missing.
easy.modelsErrorMissingKey: Enter a valid API Key before fetching the model list.
easy.modelsErrorInvalidUrl: The API base URL is invalid. Enter a complete https address and retry.
easy.modelsErrorUnauthorized: API Key rejected (401). Check that the Key is correct and not expired.
easy.modelsErrorForbidden: No permission to read the model list (403). Check Key scopes or whether the account is still active.
easy.modelsErrorBalance: Insufficient balance — the provider refused the model list. Top up or restore quota on the relay site.
easy.modelsErrorNotFound: Model list endpoint not found (404). Confirm whether the API base needs /v1, or check the provider docs.
easy.modelsErrorUnreachable: Could not reach the service (network error or timeout). Check your network and API address.
easy.modelsErrorEmpty: The provider returned an empty model list. You can continue with a prefilled or default model, or verify model names on the site.
easy.modelsErrorUnavailable: Model list request failed (HTTP {{code}}). You can continue with a prefilled or default model, or retry later.
easy.modelsErrorUnavailableGeneric: Model list request failed. You can continue with a prefilled or default model, or retry later.
easy.installSuccessBody: CLI is ready. Return to the main window to continue.
easy.deleteConfirm: Delete this service? If it is in use, Switch clears the matching CLI config on this machine first, then removes the service and Key.
easy.deleted: Service deleted and matching CLI config cleared.
